topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I stood over the cracked lid of the old, rusted canister, hands deep in my trench coat pockets. The rain was coming down, but it didn’t matter. Not now. I pulled out the contents with a gloved hand, running my fingers over the faded letters, the yellowed photographs, the coins that told a story of days long gone. This wasn’t just any find. It was a piece of the past, left by someone who thought they were leaving a legacy. But they didn’t. They left a mystery. And here I was, sifting through the remnants, piecing together a puzzle that no one else could solve. The city’s secrets were mine to unravel, and this was just another thread in the tapestry.
